# PRB-003: Docker API ports are not reachable from the internet

- **Group:** Outside view
- **Severity when it fails:** critical
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

The Docker API on 2375 (plain) or 2376 (TLS) gives whoever reaches it root on the host: they can start a privileged container that mounts the root filesystem. An open 2375 is scanned and abused within minutes of going public. The host side of this is DKR-002.

## Verify by hand

```sh
nc -vz -w 3 <host> 2375; nc -vz -w 3 <host> 2376   # from another machine
```

## How to fix it

Remove the tcp:// listener from the Docker daemon (hosts in daemon.json, -H in the service unit) and reach Docker over SSH or the tailnet instead.

## What a fix can break

Remote tools that talk to the TCP API (some CI runners, Portainer agents) stop working until moved to SSH or the tailnet.

Run `stackward explain PRB-003` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
